reference_sql:
WITH versions AS (
  -- one row per product and price version, with the list price of the version before it
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
    LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
), changes AS (
  -- one row per price change from 1 to 28 February 2025, with its direction and the Monday of its week
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, CAST(date_trunc('week', valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_week,
    CASE WHEN list_price_eur > prev_price THEN 'rise' ELSE 'cut' END AS change_type
  FROM versions
  WHERE list_price_eur <> prev_price
    AND valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
)
SELECT c.product_id, c.valid_from, c.change_type,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start < c.change_week THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) AS units_before,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start > c.change_week THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) AS units_after
FROM changes c
JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = c.product_id
  AND w.week_start BETWEEN c.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY AND c.change_week + INTERVAL 56 DAY
GROUP BY c.product_id, c.valid_from, c.change_type

  -- one row per product and price version, with the list price of the version before it

    LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
), changes AS (

  SELECT product_id, valid_from, CAST(date_trunc('week', valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_week, 'rise' AS change_type

)

solver.query:
WITH versions AS (
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
    LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
), chg AS (
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, CASE WHEN list_price_eur > prev_price THEN 'rise' ELSE 'cut' END AS change_type,
    CAST(date_trunc('week', valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_week
  FROM versions
  WHERE list_price_eur <> prev_price AND valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
)
SELECT r.product_id, r.valid_from, r.change_type,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start < r.change_week THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) AS units_before,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start > r.change_week THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) AS units_after
FROM chg r JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = r.product_id
  AND w.week_start BETWEEN CAST(r.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY AS DATE) AND CAST(r.change_week + INTERVAL 56 DAY AS DATE)
GROUP BY r.product_id, r.valid_from, r.change_type
